lithology_compatibility_matrix.description: Categorical similarity [0..1] between planetary target lithology and terrestrial analog lithology.

sources.name: Mars Climate Database (MCD) v6.2
sources.limitations: Coarse GCM grid (64x48); represents regional seasonal diurnal mean at Ls=105 deg, not micro-topographic shelter.

sources.name: USGS Astrogeology STAC & MOLA/HiRISE Reference DTM (Jezero Crater)
sources.provider: NASA PDS / USGS Astrogeology Science Center
sources.version: PDS4 / Mars2020 Landing Site DTM & MOLA MEGDR
sources.limitations: Topographic metrics aggregated at 100 m analysis scale within Jezero western delta/floor AOI.

sources.name: NASA PGDA LRO LOLA South Pole Site04 (Shackleton Rim)
sources.provider: NASA GSFC Planetary Geodesy Data Archive (PGDA)
sources.version: LOLA GDR / Site04 5m-20m South Pole Products
sources.limitations: High-latitude polar laser altimetry includes interpolation between orbital tracks; no atmosphere or liquid precipitation.

sources.name: OpenTopography Copernicus DEM GLO-30 / SRTM GL1
sources.crs: EPSG:4326 reprojected to local metric UTM for slope/TRI calculation at 100 m common scale
sources.limitations: Resampled to 100 m analysis scale (`analysis_scale_m = 100`) to ensure defensible cross-body comparison against planetary DTMs.

sources.name: NASA POWER Agroclimatology & Renewable Energy Climatology API
sources.limitations: 0.5 x 0.625 deg grid (~50 km); captures regional aridity and thermal regime but not canyon microclimates.

sources.name: Macrostrat Geologic Map API v2 & USGS/IGME Regional Maps
sources.limitations: Categorical lithological classification harmonized to planetary analog classes.

sources.name: NASA Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS) v2.0 Surface Reflectance
sources.limitations: Optical index omitted or low-confidence in polar winter darkness (McMurdo).
